hypotheses.statement: AgentWeave optimized-team task completion exceeds every baseline by at least 20 percentage points across the preregistered repeated-seed workload runs.
AgentWeave optimized-team mean delivered quality exceeds every baseline by at least 0.10 on the same repeated-seed workload runs.
When an induced failure is actually exercised, AgentWeave recovery succeeds in at least 90% of opportunities.

statistics.paired_significance: exact McNemar test for binary completion when paired observations are available

exploratory_external_routing_scope.purpose: post-hoc stronger semantic-router comparison on the already-frozen untouched task set; this is explicitly exploratory and is not represented as a preregistered untouched comparison
exploratory_external_routing_scope.baseline_design: zero-shot nearest family-description embedding; no General-AgentBench label or example is used to fit the embedding baseline
exploratory_external_routing_scope.failure_reporting: store all AgentWeave errors and disagreements with each semantic baseline

evidence_boundary: The confirmatory outcome benchmark physically executes controlled handlers over a synthetic agent catalog; it is an actual task-completion outcome within that benchmark, not a production-user or external-provider result. The semantic-router comparison is routing accuracy only and is exploratory/post-hoc because General-AgentBench had already been observed before these embedding baselines were added.
